product_family: AI-powered IDE and app development platform with Replit Agent for code generation, databases, authentication, and deployment across web/mobile/design applications. Pricing tiers: Starter (Free), Core, Pro, Enterprise.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Enterprise reached major security milestones: SOC 2 Type II certification with zero exceptions and an 'Advanced' Bitsight ranking (780 security score).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No direct mention of Replit holding ISO 27001 certification in own documentation. Only GCP (infrastructure provider) holds ISO 27001 certification. Replit's own company certification is limited to SOC 2 Type II.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Data Protection Law means all applicable laws...including...the General Data Protection Regulation, Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ('GDPR'). The DPA incorporates Standard Contractual Clauses required under GDPR for international data transfers.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance on Replit's own domain: its Terms of Service, security documentation, and trust center contain no HIPAA or Business Associate Agreement (BAA) language, and Replit does not advertise HIPAA eligibility. Third-party sources report that Replit does not offer a BAA, but that assertion is not confirmed by the vendor's own documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on Replit's vendor-domain documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification on Replit's vendor-domain documentation.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification on Replit's vendor-domain documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Public app content may be used for training LLMs: 'Content published in public Apps may be used by Replit for improving the Service, including but not limited to developing or training large language models.' Private apps: Replit reserves access 'for the purpose of troubleshooting, improving our service, and ensuring the safety and security of the Service'; no explicit opt-out mechanism is documented.
privacy.data_region: Configurable: North America, EU, South America, Asia, Australia. Development environments run in North America. Subprocessors include US-based companies (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Stripe, etc.).

security.name: Enterprise Controls
security.value: SSO/SAML, SOC 2, Admin controls, Secure services screening

products.name: Replit Platform (IDE/Development)
products.data_scope: Source code, user profiles, project metadata. Public projects may be used for AI training.
products.notes: Freemium tier available. Supports web, mobile, design, data visualization, 3D games. Multi-user collaboration available. Public/private project visibility options.

products.name: Replit Agent
products.data_scope: User prompts, generated code, project context. Effort-based pricing. May use project data for AI training on public projects.
products.notes: Parallel agent execution. Integrated with multiple AI models (via subprocessors: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter). Requires credits (Core: $20/mo, Pro: $100/mo includes more credits).

products.name: Replit Enterprise
products.data_scope: Same as platform plus advanced audit logs, SSO/SCIM, VPC peering, static outbound IPs, design system support, single-tenant environments.
products.notes: Custom pricing. Designed for regulated industries and enterprise compliance requirements, though HIPAA BAA not available.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + Subscription (monthly/annual). Starter (Free), Core ($20/mo), Pro ($100/mo), Enterprise (custom). Agent uses effort-based add-on pricing.
compare.data_residency: Configurable deployment regions: North America (default), EU, South America, Asia, Australia. Private development environments run in North America.

flags: ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR are not documented as Replit certifications anywhere on the vendor's domain. Only SOC 2 Type II is publicly documented by Replit. ISO 27001 and other certifications are attributed to GCP (infrastructure), not Replit itself.

HIPAA: No public evidence on Replit's own domain that it offers a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or supports HIPAA-regulated PHI workloads; its Terms of Service, security docs, and trust center contain no HIPAA/BAA language. Third-party sources report Replit does not sign BAAs, though this is not confirmed by the vendor. Absent a signed BAA, not recommended for workloads involving protected health information.
Public app content is used for LLM training per Terms of Service. Private apps reserve access for service improvement but lack an explicit opt-out.
GCP's ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications are attributed to Google Cloud, not Replit. Replit relies on GCP's infrastructure certifications but does not hold these certifications independently.
